label: Industrial Ingestion — OPC UA Client
info:
Industrial Ingestion — OPC UA Client (reference flow)

Polls 13 energy-meter variables from an OPC UA server (readmultiple),
maps OPC UA StatusCodes to the envelope quality field, normalizes into
the industrial ingestion envelope and publishes to the Kafka Bronze
ingestion topic. Read-only: no writes, no method calls.

Environment:
  OPCUA_ENDPOINT              opc.tcp URL (required; endpoint config node
                              uses ${OPCUA_ENDPOINT} substitution)
  OPCUA_POLL_MS               poll interval ms (default 5000)
  OPCUA_NODE_PREFIX           NodeId prefix (default
                              ns=1;s=FACIS.EnergyMeter.)
  OPCUA_DEVICE_ID             device id for envelope/key
  OPCUA_INGEST_TOPIC          Kafka topic (default opcua.ingest.raw)
  INDING_SITE_ID              site id for envelope
  INDING_KAFKA_BROKERS        broker list (required)

Quality mapping: Bad status or non-numeric value fails the whole cycle
to the DLQ (no partial snapshots); Uncertain marks the snapshot
quality 'uncertain' and still publishes (range filtering stays in the
Silver layer). Demo endpoint uses SecurityPolicy None + anonymous;
Sign/SignAndEncrypt are available on the endpoint config node for real
sources.
